items.claimable_statement: All 6270 selected rows in the frozen CSV snapshot pass parser -> mapping -> emission -> zero-warning grompp smoke with the custom GROMACS_PCFF build.
items.non_claimable_statement: This does not imply charged Li/TFSI support, production mdrun stability, physical parameter validation, or stock GROMACS support.

items.claimable_statement: Trajectory 14764 remains a fully inspectable no-fallback polymer-only conversion case with a zero-warning grompp PASS and generated smoke.tpr.
items.non_claimable_statement: One representative case alone is not the database claim; the database claim relies on all per-row reports plus summary.

items.claimable_statement: 870 passing rows used explicit zero-parameter fallbacks for source LUNAR labels ['S-type-yourself', 'c4o', 's_m'].
items.non_claimable_statement: Fallback use is not physical parameter-completion evidence; S-type-yourself remains a LUNAR atom-typing failure fallback.

items.claimable_statement: Excluded-distance cutoff failures are unblocked for the frozen smoke scope by deriving cutoff and smoke box dimensions from topological exclusion distances and coordinate extents.

No charged Li/TFSI, ion, dense electrolyte, conductivity-production, or general charged topology conversion support is implied by this polymer-only smoke run.
